web.description:
# First & Last Frame to Video Generator
## Two frames in, one smooth clip out
Real transitions made from a start frame and an end frame — before-and-after reveals, product morphs, and scene changes, each interpolated in the browser with no editing software.

![First last frame to video example — a before and after transformation morphed from a start frame to an end frame](https://imgveo.com/_next/image?url=%2Fimages%2Flanding%2Fstart-end-frame%2Fstart-end-frame-showcase-beforeafter.webp&w=3840&q=75)A before → after transformation![First and last frame to video example — a product reveal transition interpolated between two frames](https://imgveo.com/_next/image?url=%2Fimages%2Flanding%2Fstart-end-frame%2Fstart-end-frame-showcase-product.webp&w=3840&q=75)A product reveal between two frames![Start and end frame example — a scene morph generated by keyframe interpolation between two images](https://imgveo.com/_next/image?url=%2Fimages%2Flanding%2Fstart-end-frame%2Fstart-end-frame-showcase-morph.webp&w=3840&q=75)A scene morph from frame A to frame B

## What is first & last frame to video?
You upload the first frame and the last frame, describe the motion between them, and the model generates every frame in between, so the clip morphs smoothly from your starting image to your ending image. This is keyframe interpolation: you define both endpoints and the AI fills the journey. Image-to-video animates a single photo and invents where the motion goes, while first and last frame mode is anchored at both ends — so you get far more control over how the clip starts and exactly where it lands.

web.title: End frame in AI video: what it is and how to use it
web.description:
# End Frame
## Direct scenes, design characters, and ship full films
Using only a start frame leaves the ending open to generation; using both endpoints defines the full visual journey the model must connect.

The first photograph is the start frame and the second is the end frame. Everything in between is up to you to invent and create, but both endpoints are fixed. The model receives the starting image and the ending image and then generates all the motion, transformation, and visual change that connects them, filling in the journey between two defined destinations.

## Common use cases
- Creating a morph or transformation sequence between two specific images by defining the first as the start frame and the second as the end frame, with the generation producing the transition between them.

## FAQs
When specified alongside a start frame, it gives the generation model defined endpoints to connect through generated motion and transformation.
